selectors.tfrostend: read when SWFROST=1; input range [-10,5] C
selectors.missing_validation: No requirement that TFROSTSTA > TFROSTEND; equality can divide by zero and reversed limits invert the intended interval.

execution.temperature_owner: MOD_SoilTemperature owns TSOIL/TETOP; sensible profile is updated after each soil-water interval.
order: drainage and soil-water solve, with FrozenBounds
SoilTemperature(2) sensible update after water interval
execution.thermal_hydraulic_policy: No joint thermal-hydraulic nonlinear iteration; frost reads temperature available at the hydraulic attempt start.

effects.theta_capacity: No effect on theta(h), C(h), saturation or stored water.
effects.boundaries: FrozenBounds applies additional drainage/top/bottom flux heuristics using frost depth and available air volume.
effects.root_stress: Separate binary factor: alpfrs=0 for TSOIL<0 C, otherwise 1; SW_STRESSOR=5 selects legacy frost compensation behavior.

state.restart: Reuse admitted SWAP5 sensible-temperature state/restart; no separately stored frost factor or crossing-depth continuation is required by the B1.11 equations.
state.mass: K factor adds no storage or flux. FrozenBounds boundary flux changes must be booked once by existing boundary/drainage owners.
state.energy: No latent heat or phase-change energy state/ledger in B1.11.

confirmed_limitations: No frozen/unfrozen water partition or explicit ice content.
No latent heat or thermodynamic freeze-thaw closure.
Frost-depth interpolation may divide by zero for equal bracketing temperatures and lacks a consistent segment clamp.
The residual K floor allows tiny conductivity when rfcp=0.
Hydraulic thresholds and binary root-stress cutoff have distinct semantics and can disagree.
FrozenBounds is a separate heuristic boundary algorithm, not implied by constitutive K scaling.
